description: Corrects an answer, for example when both partners of a couple answered and each brought the other as a guest. Get the id from list_rsvps. Only the fields you pass change. If the guest answers again later, their new answer counts.

event.description: The event: its id, any of its links or the full URL

guests.description: People the guest brings along who weren't invited themselves (only for yes)

rsvpId.description: The id of the answer from list_rsvps

status.description: yes if the guest comes, no if not

name: update_rsvp
title: Correct an RSVP
